recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-7954 as historically applied and later superseded by FHIR-32020; any new concern about Resource.language search semantics should be handled through a new or later tracker, not by reapplying the 2015 removal.
issue_request: FHIR-7954 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I request from the 2015May ballot to remove _language from the default Resource-level search parameters because its general usefulness and matching semantics were unclear, while leaving room to reintroduce language search where needed.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 5430, represented in git by 340bce1f8e7a7c8cb085a7ad210afa802a852d77, which deleted the _language link and explanatory section from source/search.html.
additional_context: FHIR-32020 later reached Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and resolved to define a standard _language search parameter against Resource.language. Zulip discussion and FHIR-I WGM minutes identify multilingual questionnaire/document use cases and record the later decision to add _language.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Removing _language from current source would incorrectly undo the later FHIR-32020 decision rather than complete FHIR-7954.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 decision that deliberately reintroduced _language as a standard Resource.language search parameter.
Original pre-DSTU1 issue adding a language search parameter for all resource types, later removed by FHIR-7954.
